findings.F1: The tested result points the way the idea predicts but is far from the bar: the mean unusual 5-day move is +0.59 % (t 0.56, 155 case days, 236 cases), and in folds B and C alone it is +1.10 % (t 0.59, 76 days, 129 cases); at the same spread, t 2 would need about 13 times as many case days.
findings.F2: The rebound in the cases is strongest before the plan's horizon and fades by it: the unusual move is +1.95 % at 1 day (t 1.52), +2.70 % at 3 days (t 2.09), +1.10 % at 5 days (t 0.59) and +1.21 % at 10 days (t 0.49), on the same 129 cases and 76 days.
findings.F3: Inside the cases, the depth of the raw 30-day fall sorts the outcome the way the idea's grading says, with a Spearman of ret30 against the 5-day unusual move of −0.25. The deepest third rose +4.93 % over 5 days (t 1.14, 19 days) and +10.3 % over 10 days (t 1.60). The shallowest third fell −4.63 % (t −1.75) and −9.86 % (t −3.04, 18 days).
findings.F4: Across every new 30-day close low, not only the strategy's cases, lows reached after the smallest 30-day falls keep falling over 10 days. In the wide-range regime the shallowest third moved −10.6 % (t −2.64, 16 days); outside it, −7.6 % (t −2.13, 27 days). At 5 days the figures were −4.7 % (t −1.83) and −3.0 % (t −1.89). The deepest third in the regime stayed near zero, at −0.45 % over 5 days and +0.27 % over 10 days.
findings.F5: The rebound is mixed across coins and years. Per case over 5 days, BTC moved +2.4 %, XMR +5.3 % and ZEC +4.3 %, against ETH −0.9 %, LTC −0.6 % and XRP −3.3 %. By year, only 2021 is clearly positive (+4.4 %, t 2.15); 2018 was −1.4 % and 2020 −1.6 %.
findings.F6: The strategy's own forecast grades the move only weakly: the lowest forecast third moved −2.4 %, the middle +2.6 % and the highest +3.0 %. The supporting Spearman is 0.066, against the raw 30-day fall's −0.25 in F3, which suggests the 60-day standardisation blurs the grading.

ideas.name: deep-low rebound, all coins
ideas.idea: In a coin whose daily high-low ranges over the past 30 days are wide compared with its own past year, a close at a new 30-day low is followed by a rise over the next 5 days. The larger the coin's 30-day fall into that low, the larger the rise.
ideas.consequence: Rebound. The longer and deeper the volatile fall before the new monthly low, the more of the forced-seller pool is already liquidated.

ideas.idea: In a coin whose daily high-low ranges over the past 30 days are wide compared with its own past year, a close at a new 30-day low is followed by a rise over the next 3 days. The larger the coin's 30-day fall into that low, the larger the rise.
ideas.consequence: A trader buying a volatile monthly low after a deep fall would take the rebound within about 3 days, before it fades.
ideas.name: deep-low three-day rebound

ideas.idea: In a coin whose daily high-low ranges over the past 30 days are wide compared with its own past year, a close at a new 30-day low is followed by a further fall over the next 10 days. The smaller the coin's 30-day fall into that low, the larger the further fall.
ideas.consequence: A trader should refuse to buy a fresh monthly low that comes after only a mild 30-day decline, and may short it instead, because such lows tend to break down further.
ideas.name: shallow-fall low breakdown
